evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no customer concerns raised for rep to probe; rep only asks logistics questions (floor, parking, hallway distance, item dimensions, box count, destination details).

evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Arden: 'if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated and of course you pay less' — covered.

top_strength: Rep methodically gathered all logistics details (floor, parking, hallway distance, item inventory, destination layout, box count) with clarity and confirmed facts; the move parameters are thoroughly documented for the crew.
coaching_note: Skip the logistics deep-dive until you've asked 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' and earned the right to probe—this call became a data-collection exercise with no trust-building, no differentiators, and no close; you gave a price but never asked for the booking.
